mapper.select: select id, batch_no, channel, currency, total_count, total_amount, status, cutoff_time, create_time, update_time from cross_border_settlement_batch where batch_no = #{batchNo}
select id, batch_no, channel, currency, total_count, total_amount, status, cutoff_time, create_time, update_time from cross_border_settlement_batch order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into cross_border_settlement_batch (batch_no, channel, currency, total_count, total_amount, status, cutoff_time) values (#{batchNo}, #{channel}, #{currency}, #{totalCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{cutoffTime})
mapper.update: update cross_border_settlement_batch set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where batch_no = #{batchNo}
update cross_border_settlement_batch set total_count = #{totalCount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, update_time = now() where batch_no = #{batchNo}
update cross_border_settlement_batch set status = 2, update_time = now() where status = 1 and cutoff_time <= #{now}
